note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first eleven candidates, and the home router lost many lookups, so the rest were tried only on pages whose address was known or could be reached (court, city and school district pages, the House Republicans' member pages, the U.S. Taxpayers Party's home page). Not reached: the Governor's press releases (the state's site refuses scripts), the board pages of Grand Rapids, Royal Oak, West Bloomfield and Lamphere schools. Looked at and nothing recorded: East Grand Rapids' board page does not list Paul Bratt and Detroit's board page does not list Calesther Smith-Arnold (neither sits on the board today); the House Republicans' pages for Jason Woolford and Brian BeGole link no campaign website; the U.S. Taxpayers Party's home page showed no candidate list. No campaign website, birth year or party endorsement was confirmed for anyone in this part. A blank means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
